title: Observability Lab — Logging, Metrics, Tracing, Alerting
title_es: Laboratorio de Observabilidad — Logging, Métricas, Tracing, Alertas
description: Runnable observability stack lab: OpenTelemetry-instrumented payment service, OTel Collector config, Prometheus alert rules (including SLO burn rate), and a docker-compose setup with Jaeger, Prometheus, Loki and Grafana.
description_es: Laboratorio ejecutable de observabilidad: servicio de pagos instrumentado con OpenTelemetry, configuración del OTel Collector, reglas de alerta de Prometheus (incluido burn rate de SLO) y un docker-compose con Jaeger, Prometheus, Loki y Grafana.
